//type: ESM, and it has to be declared. Without this field Node treats these .ts files as CommonJS, and a `export * from './x.js'` in index.ts compiles to a runtime re-export that cjs-module-lexer cannot see through — so a named import of anything re-exported (e.g. ANALYSIS_REASON_CODES) fails to link, while a namespace import of the same module works. Both consumers are ESM already: the repo root and apps/api declare type: module, and apps/web is bundled.
